skills.name: authoring-skills

skills.name: commit-messages

skills.name: gitlab-agent-plan

skills.name: gitlab-babysit-mr
skills.description: Monitor a GitLab MR's pipeline until green. Classifies failures (flaky, master-broken, lint, coverage, real), retries jobs where appropriate, makes light-touch auto-fixes, and posts findings as an MR comment.

skills.name: gitlab-clickhouse

skills.name: gitlab-pipeline-watch
skills.description: Watch GitLab MR pipelines and react to state changes

skills.name: gitlab-psql
skills.description: Inspect GitLab GDK PostgreSQL test and development databases with gdk psql. Use for Postgres schema checks, table and index inspection, read-only SQL queries, migration verification, and investigating GitLab application data in local test or development databases.

skills.name: glab
skills.description: GitLab workflow automation using the glab CLI. Use when the user asks to create, update, close, label, or comment on a GitLab issue, merge request, work item, or epic; to post a note, review comment, or discussion reply; to call the GitLab REST or GraphQL API through "glab api"; to inspect or retry pipelines and jobs; or to configure glab auth against gitlab.com, a self-managed instance, or a local GDK. Read it before any glab write operation, because several field flags fail silently - they exit 0 while posting the wrong content.

skills.name: glab-glql

skills.name: handoff

skills.name: mr-adversarial-review
skills.description: Use when running a critical, skeptical pass over a GitLab MR — either as the author before requesting human review, or as a reviewer wanting a structured first cut — produces a severity-bucketed findings report (High / Medium / Low / Done well) and posts it as a single comment on the MR.

skills.name: mr-guided-review
skills.description: Use when you want to understand and review a GitLab MR as a reasoning companion rather than an automated reviewer. Phase 1 explains the MR's goal and purpose concisely with a concrete example, then gates on your confirmation before Phase 2 does a thorough code review that surfaces genuine issues, not nitpicks. Read-only — never posts anything to the MR; you post any feedback yourself. Triggers when you want to review, understand, or walk through an MR.

skills.name: mr-review
skills.description: Review a GitLab merge request - read diffs, analyze changes, present findings, and optionally post comments on the MR

skills.name: opencode-refine

skills.name: pushify

Invoke when: (a) about to push and wanting hooks to pass cleanly, (b) `git push` has just failed on a pre-push hook and the failure needs to be driven to resolution, or (c) preparing a clean working tree without pushing — e.g. before opening a Draft MR for early review.

skills.name: run-in-tmux-pane

skills.name: rust-unsafe-ffi-review

skills.name: self-service-performance-testing

Use when the user is adding or changing API endpoints, database queries, critical paths, or frontend pages and needs to decide whether to write a performance test, what kind, or how to integrate it into CI.
